  item = missingValue
  page = merge todos first 3 by byOwner:
    [item.ownerId] for x in todos[viewer] first 2 by byOwner
  return missingAfter

files.snapback/todos.q:
mutation complete(todoId: todos):
  match todos[todoId]:
    some row:
      lost = missingThen
    none:
      update todos[todoId] { done: "yes" }
  return missingAfter
